blocks.text: Jollibee teams up with Filipino pastry chef Nouel Catis, whose work is associated with the Dubai chocolate phenomenon, to launch the ₱79 Pistachio Choco Sundae, a limited-edition Christmas dessert available nationwide in the Philippines from October 16 to December 31, 2026.
